nextStoryContext: US-008 extended src/supervisor/events.ts with 4 new WorkerEventKind values (merge-watch-watching, merge-watch-merged, merge-watch-ci-red, merge-watch-post-merge-done) plus typed detail interfaces (MergeWatchWatchingEventDetail, MergeWatchMergedEventDetail, MergeWatchCiRedEventDetail, MergeWatchPostMergeDoneEventDetail) added to the WorkerEventDetail union. src/release/merge-watch.ts gained an optional logEvent?(kind, detail) injectable on MergeWatchOptions; runMergeWatch emits: merge-watch-watching at loop start, merge-watch-merged on MERGED state, merge-watch-post-merge-done after post-merge (ok:true or ok:false), merge-watch-ci-red with reason:'blocked' on OPEN+BLOCKED and reason:'closed' on CLOSED. 5 new tests in test/release/merge-watch.test.ts under 'runMergeWatch structured events (US-008)' assert happy path (watching->merged->post-merge-done) and CI-red path (watching->ci-red). Production sidecar wiring of logEvent into the file event logger is a follow-up (the injectable seam is in place; production wiring follows the US-R1-002 dep-builder pattern). 1644 tests all pass.
